# Linear Algebra

Matrix multiplication: (AB)ᵢⱼ = ∑ₖ Aᵢₖ Bₖⱼ

Transpose: (Aᵀ)ᵢⱼ = Aⱼᵢ

The inner product ⟨u, v⟩ = ∑ᵢ uᵢvᵢ.

A matrix A ∈ ℝⁿˣⁿ is orthogonal if AᵀA = I.

Eigenvalues satisfy det(A − λI) = 0.

The norm ∥v∥ = √(v₁² + v₂² + v₃²).

Cauchy-Schwarz: |⟨u, v⟩| ≤ ∥u∥ · ∥v∥.

The null space N(A) = {x ∈ ℝⁿ : Ax = 0}.

Rank-nullity: dim(V) = rank(A) + nullity(A).

SVD: A = UΣVᵀ where U, V are orthogonal and Σ is diagonal.
